title: A Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Recognition of Hand-Drawn Geometric Shapes
abstract: arXiv:2609.24384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28x28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters) with max-pooling, an in-model data-augmentation stage (random horizontal flip, rotation, and zoom), a dropout-regularized dense layer of 128 units, and a 4-way linear output layer, totaling 97{,}956 trainable parameters. translated_title: 一种用于手绘几何图形实时识别的轻量级卷积神经网络
translated_abstract: 识别手绘几何图形是草图识别的一个基础子问题，在教育、人机交互和图表数字化等领域具有广泛应用。本文介绍了一款桌面应用程序的设计、实现与评估，该程序使用紧凑的卷积神经网络（CNN）识别四种基本的手绘几何图形：圆形、正方形、长方形和三角形。研究团队独立收集并公开发布了一个包含2,000张带标签的28x28像素形状图像的数据集。该分类器由三个卷积块（分别包含16、32和64个卷积核）与最大池化组成，包含模型内数据增强阶段（随机水平翻转、旋转和缩放）、一个经dropout正则化的128单元全连接层，以及一个4分类线性输出层，总计97,956个可训练参数。该网络使用Adam优化器，在直接基于logits计算的稀疏分类交叉熵目标上进行训练。在8（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个仅含约9.8万可训练参数的轻量级卷积神经网络，结合模型内数据增强技术，实现了对圆形、正方形、长方形和三角形四种手绘几何图形的实时识别，并公开发布了包含2,000张图像的自建数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a lightweight CNN with only 97,956 trainable parameters that achieves real-time recognition of four hand-drawn geometric shapes (circle, square, rectangle, and triangle), accompanied by a publicly released dataset of 2,000 labeled images.
